1. (Currently amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the cell is a eukaryotic cell__.

2. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1]] __1,__ wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1]] __1,__ wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme.

4. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[3]] __3,__ wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

5. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[3er-ctaim-4]] __3 or 4__ wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1any-preceding-claim]] __1__ wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

7. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[6]] __6,__ wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

8. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1any pr-eceding-claim]] __1__ wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

9. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[8]] __8,__ wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[8]] __8,__ wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons.

11. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1any-preeeding-claim]] __1__ wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag.

12. (Currently amended) A method __of producing a non-native compartment in a host cell,__ comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide, __wherein the host cell is a eukaryotic cell__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[12]] __12,__ wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[13]] __13,__ wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[14]] __14,__ wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[13]] __13,__ wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[12]] __12,__ wherein the host cell comprises a yeast.

18. (Original) The method of claim17wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Original) The method of claim18wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[12]] __12,__ wherein the host cell comprises an alga.

21. (Currently amended) A method __of producing a product in a cell,__ comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product, __wherein the cell is a eukaryotic cell__.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[21]] __21,__ wherein the product comprises a bioactive product.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[21]] __21,__ wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[21]] __21,__ wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[21]] __21,__ wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim [[21further]] __21, further__ comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments.

27. 28. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1anye nee f-elaims-1-11]] __1__ comprising a plurality of compartments.
